title: Sum of digits
description:
Write `int digitSum(int n)` that adds the digits of a non-negative number: `digitSum(472)` is 4 + 7 + 2 = 13.

You do not know how many digits there are, so a `while` loop fits: keep going while there is something left.

- `n % 10` is the last digit.
- `n / 10` removes the last digit.
hints: Each time round the loop: add `n % 10` (the last digit) to the total, then do `n /= 10` to drop that digit. Stop when `n` reaches 0.
Try it on paper with 472: the loop sees 472, then 47, then 4, then 0.
